lines.1: Before I know it, we're at the end-of-day homeroom.
lines.2: 「Tsushima, please gather everyone's career-interview date forms and bring them to me.」
lines.4: 「There is something I would like to discuss with you.」
lines.8: Entering the staff room always makes me a little nervous.
lines.12: 「Thank you. Have a piece of candy.」
lines.13: She gives me one of the cheap sweets scattered across her desk.
lines.15: 「I am fighting with that bird. I believe whoever apologizes first loses.」
lines.16: What sort of teacher fights with a bird?
lines.17: 「Tsushima, do you have any idea why I called you here?」
lines.21: H-How does she know what I'm thinking?
lines.22: 「...Tsushima, look here. The mysteries of the universe lie within.」
lines.24: 「I'm not looking! Th-That's reverse sexual harassment, ma'am.」
lines.25: What is wrong with her all of a sudden?
lines.28: She pulls a string of international flags from her chest.
lines.29: 「I have chosen you, Tsushima. This weekend will be a feast.」
lines.32: 「I would like to speak somewhere different this weekend. Just the two of us.」
lines.33: 「Stay late with the Executive Committee on Friday. I will come for you.」
lines.39: How does she know what I'm thinking?
lines.46: 「I read your fortune earlier. It says you will suffer a traffic accident within twenty-four hours.」
lines.48: 「My predictions are one hundred percent accurate. Remain constantly alert and minimize the harm.」
lines.49: Inori's predictions really do hit the mark.
lines.50: 「Even if you try to change fate, that altered result becomes your true fate. Do not forget.」
lines.51: Still... What is happening this weekend?
lines.52: It sounds frightening, yet somehow exciting.
lines.53: Thinking about it, I head home while watching carefully for cars.
